title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten documented no-cost ways to spend time together at Hampden-Sydney, from student equipment loans to free public performances and exhibitions.

cards.title: Borrow Bikes for a Group Ride
cards.subtitle: Free student equipment from the Office of Student Affairs
cards.notes: Gather a few classmates, check out cruiser or mountain bikes from Student Affairs, and choose a route suited to everyone’s ability.
cards.short_summary: Turn a free bicycle checkout into an easy campus ride with friends.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney lists cruiser and mountain bikes under its “FREE Equipment Rental” program and tells students to borrow equipment from the Office of Student Affairs.
cards.access_notes: For Hampden-Sydney students; contact or visit the Office of Student Affairs to check availability and complete any required waiver.

cards.title: Plan a No-Cost Campout
cards.subtitle: Borrow tents, tarps, and camping essentials through Student Affairs
cards.notes: Reserve the shared camping kit first, then pick an authorized campsite and confirm weather, transportation, and return arrangements.
cards.short_summary: Build an overnight outdoor plan around loaned tents and essential gear.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s “FREE Equipment Rental” inventory includes tents, tarps, and camping essentials available to borrow from the Office of Student Affairs.
cards.access_notes: For Hampden-Sydney students; obtain permission for the chosen campsite and confirm equipment availability with Student Affairs.

cards.title: Set Up a Cornhole Match
cards.subtitle: Free boards and bags from the Office of Student Affairs
cards.notes: Check out the boards and bags, choose a level open area that does not block paths, and organize a short round-robin with friends.
cards.short_summary: Create a casual outdoor tournament using the College’s loaner set.
cards.evidence_claim: Cornhole boards and bags appear in Hampden-Sydney’s “FREE Equipment Rental” inventory available through the Office of Student Affairs.
cards.access_notes: For Hampden-Sydney students; borrow the set through Student Affairs and use it only in an authorized campus area.

cards.title: Borrow Kayaks for a Paddle
cards.subtitle: Student loan equipment for nearby waterways
cards.notes: Confirm the launch site and conditions before borrowing kayaks, then bring required safety gear and paddle with a partner.
cards.short_summary: Organize a student paddle without paying to rent the College’s kayaks.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney lists kayaks in its “FREE Equipment Rental” inventory and says students can borrow equipment from the Office of Student Affairs.
cards.access_notes: For Hampden-Sydney students; contact Student Affairs, complete the applicable waiver, and verify water and transport conditions.

cards.title: Team Up for a Canoe Outing
cards.subtitle: Borrow a canoe through the free student equipment program
cards.notes: Choose paddling partners, arrange safe transport, and check water conditions before collecting the canoe and required equipment.
cards.short_summary: Practice teamwork on the water with a College-loaned canoe.
cards.evidence_claim: Canoes are included in Hampden-Sydney’s “FREE Equipment Rental” inventory, which students may borrow from the Office of Student Affairs.
cards.access_notes: For Hampden-Sydney students; coordinate checkout and the required waiver with Student Affairs before going to the water.

cards.title: Try Stand-Up Paddleboarding
cards.subtitle: Free SUP checkout through the Office of Student Affairs
cards.notes: Borrow a board with friends, select calm permitted water, and review basic balance and safety practices before launching.
cards.short_summary: Use the student loan program to try a different kind of group paddle.
cards.evidence_claim: Stand-up paddleboards are part of Hampden-Sydney’s “FREE Equipment Rental” inventory available from the Office of Student Affairs.
cards.access_notes: For Hampden-Sydney students; complete the applicable waiver and confirm equipment, water, and transportation conditions.

cards.title: Play Tadpole Holes Disc Golf
cards.subtitle: Free loaner discs for the wooded campus course
cards.notes: Borrow discs from the Fitness Center, meet outside the course area, and keep the group clear of other players’ throwing lines.
cards.short_summary: Play the named campus course using freely borrowed Frisbee-golf equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney identifies Tadpole Holes as an 18-hole campus disc-golf course and lists Frisbees for Frisbee Golf under “FREE Equipment Rental.”
cards.access_notes: Loaner discs are identified at the H-SC Fitness Center; check current availability and course conditions before starting.

cards.title: Catch a Music Series Concert
cards.subtitle: Free public performances during the academic year
cards.notes: Check the series page for the next program and venue, invite a group, and arrive early enough to find seats together.
cards.short_summary: Share a live concert without buying admission or a ticket.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney states that its Music Series presents free public concerts throughout the academic year and that all listed events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public at no charge; consult the official series page for the current program, date, time, and campus venue.

cards.title: See a Main-Stage Play
cards.subtitle: Free public performances in Johns Auditorium
cards.notes: Review the current production dates, choose a performance with friends, and reach Johns Auditorium before the announced start.
cards.short_summary: Make a theatre night of one of the College’s two annual main-stage productions.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney says its Fine Arts department produces two main-stage theatre productions each year and that all performances are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: The Theatre Program at Hampden-Sydney College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public at no charge; verify the current production schedule and any seating instructions on the official page.

cards.title: Browse the Gallery Together
cards.subtitle: A free campus art exhibition space in the Viar-Christ Center
cards.notes: Check the Fine Arts calendar for the current exhibition, then meet inside Brinkley Hall and compare one work each person noticed.
cards.short_summary: Use a rotating campus exhibition as the starting point for a group conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney identifies The Gallery in the Viar-Christ Center as a space with a major exhibition each semester and states that all College visual-arts events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public at no charge for visual-arts events; confirm the current exhibition and building access before visiting.
